principle: Create practical-nursing content only where a real regulated role/exam or registration pathway exists. Do not fabricate a lower-tier nursing designation for countries without a direct equivalent.

pathways.scopeNote: REx-PN is the regulatory practical-nurse exam used by CNO and BCCNM. Provincial/territorial practical-nurse regulation and terminology must be checked before nationalizing legal/scope claims.
Use the 2026 NCLEX-PN Test Plan effective April 1, 2026 through March 31, 2029. State nurse-practice acts vary; scope claims must be state-neutral unless a state is explicitly targeted.

Base content on NMBA Enrolled nurse standards for practice and current Ahpra EN examination requirements. The 2016 standards remain published while the 2026 standards review outcome must be monitored before treating proposed revisions as final.

pathways.examLabel: Nursing Council Enrolled Nurse State Final Examination
pathways.scopeNote: Use the Nursing Council 2025 Enrolled Nurse scope/standards. The 2026 state final examination uses medicine calculations plus nursing knowledge; IQN enrolled nurses have a 90-question theoretical examination plus clinical competence assessment where applicable.

pathways.examLabel: NMC Nursing Associate Test of Competence
pathways.scopeNote: Nursing Associate is a distinct regulated role and must not be presented as an LPN/LVN clone. ToC includes a CBT (numeracy + clinical) and OSCE and maps to NMC Nursing Associate standards of proficiency.

Use SANC scope-of-practice rules and current examination/registration requirements. Enrolled nurse practice occurs within the nursing regimen planned and initiated by a registered nurse or registered midwife under direct or indirect supervision under the cited scope framework.

NMBI's current Register divisions include registered general, children's, psychiatric, intellectual-disability, public-health and advanced/pr prescribing divisions, but no direct RPN/LPN/Enrolled Nurse/Nursing Associate equivalent. Do not fabricate a practical-nursing exam pathway.
primaryAuthorities: Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland

unverifiedCountriesRule: Any additional NurseNest country/locale must receive regulator/exam verification before a practical-nursing pathway is created. Language/localization support alone is not evidence that an equivalent regulated role exists.
